name: jills
description: Jills: saved agent workflows that Jev suggests from chat and runs in isolated worktrees.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:addons
scripts.test:addons: pnpm --dir addons/dsh run build && pnpm --dir addons/pi run typecheck && node --test --test-concurrency=3 --test-timeout=90000 addons/pi/test/jills-pi.test.ts 'addons/dsh/test/*.test.mjs'
scripts.smoke:dsh: pnpm --dir addons/dsh run build && pnpm --dir addons/dsh run smoke
